resources.string: 1. FOUR DRILL MODES (Tap top-left MODE pill)

• INTERVALS: 12 chromatic intervals (m2..P8) in Ascending, Descending, Harmonic, or Mixed style.
• CHORDS: 12 triad & 7th qualities (Major, Minor, dim, aug, sus2/4, Dom7, Maj7, m7).
• SOLFEGE: Chromatic scale degrees (Ra..Do') over a I-IV-V-I cadence or Root drone.
• MELODIC: 3-note melodic cells & 3-chord harmonic cadences (I-IV-V, ii-V-I).

• You get 3 guesses per question. Use HINT (-2) to eliminate two wrong choices.\n• Once revealed, tap ANY of the 12 pads to audition & compare intervals or chords against the current root note on both the 6-string Fretboard and Piano strip!
Tap any key on the 2-octave Piano strip or any string/fret on the 6-string Guitar Neck at any time to pluck notes and verify intervals by ear.
